## Sitemap and canonical

- Appended exactly 12 canonical HTTPS URLs to `sitemap.xml`; 63 → 75 entries. All original entries were preserved, in order. New entries carry `lastmod` 2026-09-17.
- Every new article has exactly one self-referencing canonical using `https://getdetailerfit.com/<slug>` with no `.html` suffix. Open Graph URL and Article/Breadcrumb structured data agree.
- Existing canonicals and redirects remain unchanged.

## Editorial separation

- `best-auto-detailing-invoicing-software.html`: Do not make this another general CRM roundup; keep the page centered on invoice/billing workflow.
- `best-auto-detailing-estimating-software.html`: Keep 'estimating' primary; link to CRM rather than repeating CRM selection criteria.
- `best-auto-detailing-payment-software.html`: Avoid generic merchant-processing advice; focus on software used inside a detailing workflow.
- `best-auto-detailing-route-optimization-software.html`: Use 'route optimization' only where vendors actually publish optimization; distinguish route display from optimization.
- `best-auto-detailing-job-management-software.html`: Keep the angle operational/job-day focused, not lead management or general CRM.
- `best-auto-detailing-quoting-software.html`: Differentiate from estimating page: this page is customer-facing proposal/approval; estimating page is price construction/vehicle data.
- `best-auto-detailing-lead-management-software.html`: Do not repeat full CRM comparison; judge tools on pre-booking lead handling.
- `best-auto-detailing-marketing-automation-software.html`: Keep this about marketing automation; do not compete with AI software guide on AI-agent capabilities.
- `urable-pricing.html`: Keep pricing factual and source-dated; do not duplicate a full Urable review.
- `orbisx-pricing.html`: Do not invent unlisted add-on prices; mark unknowns explicitly.
- `urable-alternatives.html`: Do not duplicate Urable vs X pages; this is a multi-option decision page.
- `orbisx-alternatives.html`: Avoid restating the OrbisX review; center each section on 'why choose this instead'.

Recommendations are workflow-specific editorial judgments based on linked official vendor documentation, not hands-on tests. Prices and plan conditions were source-checked. Unpublished charges are identified as unknown; illustrative calculations are labeled.
